# weller: ZFS root, no disk encryption (replaces LUKS+Btrfs)

The owner is installing weller RIGHT NOW (new X870E Tomahawk / 9950X3D / RTX 4090 build) and has
ruled: no whole-disk encryption, ZFS root. The current `hosts/weller/disk-config.nix` is LUKS →
Btrfs subvolumes; `hosts/weller/hardware.nix` is written around that. Convert both, update the
build doc, PR. Speed matters — the owner will install straight from your branch, so push early
and keep the branch buildable at every commit.

## Read first

- `hosts/weller/disk-config.nix`, `hosts/weller/hardware.nix`, `hosts/weller/default.nix`,
  `flake.nix` (targets `weller` and `weller-bootstrap`).
- `hosts/classic-laddie/hardware.nix` — the ZFS conventions to mirror: `networking.hostId`,
  `boot.supportedFilesystems = [ "zfs" ]`, `boot.zfs.forceImportRoot = false` with its comment,
  and the stable-kernel pin `boot.kernelPackages = lib.mkOverride 60 pkgs.linuxPackages;` with
  its rationale (ZFS kernel cap 6.19 vs linux-zen 7.0.x from `modules/common/gaming.nix`; scx
  still works on stable). Weller imports gaming.nix too, so it needs the SAME pin — copy the
  mechanism and a condensed version of the rationale.
- `docs/weller-build-2026.md` — the install doc that must end up matching.

## disk-config.nix — target layout

Same device by-id (`nvme-Seagate_FireCuda_510_SSD_ZP2000GM30001_7QE00F0P`). GPT:

1. `ESP` 1G, EF00, vfat, `/boot`, same mount options as today.
2. `swap` 32G, a real swap partition (`content.type = "swap"`, `randomEncryption` OFF — plain).
   Swap on a zvol is a known deadlock path under memory pressure; that is why it is a partition.
   No hibernation requirement.
3. `zfs` 100% → `content.type = "zfs"; pool = "<name>"`.

Pool (`disko.devices.zpool.<name>`): name it something distinct from laddie's `rpool`/`tank` so a
rescue import on classic-laddie can never collide — use `wpool`. `type = "zpool"` single disk.
`options.ashift = "12"; options.autotrim = "on"`. `rootFsOptions`: `compression = "zstd"`,
`atime = "off"`, `xattr = "sa"`, `acltype = "posixacl"`, `mountpoint = "none"`,
`"com.sun:auto-snapshot" = "false"`. Datasets (all `type = "zfs_fs"`, `mountpoint` legacy-style
as disko's zfs examples do):

- `wpool/root` → `/`
- `wpool/nix` → `/nix` (atime off already inherited; no snapshots — note it)
- `wpool/home` → `/home` (the dataset the owner will snapshot and `zfs send` to laddie's `tank`)

Keep the header comment's install instructions (the `nix run github:nix-community/disko` line)
accurate for the new file; drop every LUKS/Btrfs remark. Keep the "WARNING: wipes the disk" line.

## hardware.nix

- `boot.supportedFilesystems = [ "zfs" "ntfs" ]`.
- `networking.hostId` — generate one (`head -c4 /dev/urandom | od -A none -t x4`) and commit it.
- `boot.zfs.forceImportRoot = false;` with laddie's one-line reason.
- The stable-kernel pin (see above) — mandatory or the system does not build.
- `boot.initrd.availableKernelModules`: keep `amdgpu` but REWRITE its comment — the LUKS-prompt
  rationale is gone; it now exists so the console works on the iGPU if the 4090 is absent.
  Keep `nvme`/`xhci_pci`/`ahci`/`usbhid`/`sd_mod`, `systemd.enable = true`.
- Keep the FireCuda APST `nvme_core.default_ps_max_latency_us=0` param and its comment.
- Retitle the "Filesystem" section comment to ZFS; remove all LUKS/Btrfs mentions.

## default.nix / flake

Check nothing in `hosts/weller/default.nix` or the bootstrap target assumes Btrfs/LUKS (e.g.
btrfs scrub services, `boot.initrd.luks`, a swapfile path). `weller-bootstrap` must build with
the new layout too.

## docs/weller-build-2026.md

Update the disk/partition description and the install steps (disko command, no passphrase step,
ZFS pool name, hostId note) so the doc matches what the owner will actually run tonight. Add a
short "backup" line: `zfs snapshot` + `zfs send` of `wpool/home` to classic-laddie's `tank/personal`
replaces the old rsync approach — one sentence, no procedure.

## Constraints

- Match the repo's comment idiom: rationale in comments, information-dense, no filler. No
  multi-line prose blocks where a sentence does.
- Do not touch classic-laddie's files or any shared module.
- Do not enable ZFS native encryption or any encryption — explicitly ruled out.

## Acceptance

- `nix flake check` passes — PASTE the final lines. Also PASTE the last lines of
  `nix build .#nixosConfigurations.weller.config.system.build.toplevel --dry-run` (or a full
  build if fast enough) and the same for `weller-bootstrap`, proving both evaluate against the new
  disk layout with the stable kernel + ZFS.
- `nix run .#fmt` idempotent.
- PR titled `weller: ZFS root, no disk encryption`; body lists the layout and the kernel trade.
- Commit + push before long verification; never background a nix build and exit without
  committing.
